title: Malicious PDF Temporal Feature Dataset (sample)
description:
A sample of the feature data used in: D.-S. Choi, T. Kim, B. Kang, and E. G. Im, "Machine learning-based detection method for malicious PDF files: A temporal classification approach," Applied Soft Computing, vol. 189, 114461, 2026 (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.asoc.2025.114461).

The dataset contains 1,000 randomly sampled PDF files for each of three groups (benign, old malicious, recent malicious), 3,000 in total, as two feature sets: FS31 (31 basic structural features) and FS43 (the 31 basic features plus the 12 features proposed in the paper). It is a part of the experimental data, not the full dataset. Only extracted features are included; PDF files, file names, and file hashes are not.

If you use this data, please cite the article above.
